nodes.summary: Day log: tunnel command family rounds 3-4 review fixes plus round 5 hardening (commit f694659, unpushed). Branch fix/gui-debug-env-session-improvements based on 8cbf83a. Lands (P1-1) forwarding success determination: try_ssh_tunnel adds -v + -o LogLevel=DEBUG1, wait_for_forward uses three-condition check (ssh stderr binding marker + port reachable + child alive), background thread drains stderr, fail-then-kill-reap; (P1-2) PID must own the forward -> drops -f, explicit -o ControlMaster=no; (P1-3) restart semantics -> discover_live_session() shared helper for attach/restart, restart prechecks before disconnect; (P2-4) Config::digest() hashes port_explicit. Default-port non-constraint: Config.port_explicit from VB_PORT presence or target.port.is_some(). Round 5 hardening: -v only raises LogLevel when user config does not set it (QUIET silences binding marker - so explicit -o LogLevel=DEBUG1 required); parameterized polling budget TUNNEL_FORWARD_BUDGET=20s; numeric port boundary check (port 30001 must not match port 3000); E0716 fix via snapshot() returning owned String. All gates green (fmt/clippy/test/build --features daemon). Pitfall: shell is zsh not fish - globs must be quoted.
